Probe Lark
Mission Date: 2027-02-01
Telemetry Log Entry: 14:37 UTC

Signal reception confirmed during passive listening pass beneath icy ridge at 12:18 UTC. Seven pulses detected at regular intervals, consistent with artificial modulation. Pulse duration: 0.32 seconds; interval: 1.87 seconds. Source location estimated within 1.2 km of current position, below surface layer. No surface image obtained due to camera shutter remaining closed. Diagnostic check confirms actuator integrity; shutter status remains in locked position. No fault reported in imaging subsystem. Repeated command sequence issued; no response. Proceeding with repeat listening pass at 15:45 UTC. Plan to reattempt imaging after successful signal acquisition. Probe Lark remains on standby. Seven pulses received. No surface image. Repeat listening pass scheduled.
